Subject: Qualification: procurement readiness & approvals at Novus Health

Hi Claire — thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can line up the right docs and next meeting with procurement/finance.

Recap of what I heard:
- Primary use case: scaling a customer-facing summarization feature for clinical notes (pilot now, prod target Q3).
- Expected starting throughput: ~1M tokens/month, growth to ~5M in 12 months.
- Procurement mindset: finance wants predictable unit economics and auditability; procurement team prefers a PO process.

Open qualification items I mentioned during the call (can you confirm?):
1) Payment method: Will this be PO on Net-30 (preferred) or payment by corporate card for the pilot?
2) Procurement system: Do you transact via Ariba/Coupa/Oracle or do you accept emailed POs to vendor finance?
3) Signatory & budget owner: Who signs the master services agreement (MSA)? Who owns the budget (economic buyer)?
4) Marketplace preference: Are you interested in transacting through the cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace) for consolidated billing?

If you can confirm those 4 items, we’ll route the right quote and MSA path. I’ve attached a short commercial quote and an MSA executive summary for procurement to review.

Next suggested steps:
- If PO path: I’ll prep a formal quote and a draft MSA and propose a quick call including your procurement lead + finance (20–30 min).
- If card path: we can proceed with a pilot agreement and expedited invoice flow.

Would you be available next week for a 20-min procurement alignment? I’ll loop in Monica from Customer Success to cover onboarding/SLAs.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-commercial-quote-NOVUS-0426.pdf (quote, includes list price + pilot discount), redwood-msa-executive-summary.pdf (1-pager)
From: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@novushealth.com>

Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 17:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Qualification: procurement readiness & approvals at Novus Health

Thanks, Sergio — helpful recap. Quick answers below to your numbered items:

1) Payment method: For the pilot, we typically use corporate card to move faster, but for production we require a PO (Net-30 or Net-45 depending on vendor). We prefer to lock pricing via PO.
2) Procurement system: We use Ariba for production contracts and POs. For pilots, procurement will accept emailed POs if we indicate it’s a short-term pilot.
3) Signatory & budget owner: CFO (Mark Holloway) is the contractual signatory for commitments > $50k. Budget owner for this initiative is Ellen Park (Head of Data Science). Ellen will be the economic buyer and will sign off on the business case.
4) Marketplace preference: We prefer AWS Marketplace for consolidated billing, but it’s not a hard requirement — if Redwood can appear on the marketplace within the quarter that’s a plus.

Timeline: Ellen has budget planning meetings the week of June 7; procurement would move once Ellen confirms budget (target decision window mid-June to early July).

Next: I’m happy to set up a 30-minute alignment with procurement and finance. Can you include a simple quote with PO terms and the MSA summary? Also, please include any controls info (data residency, SOC2 scope) — procurement may ask.

Claire
Claire Bennett
Director of Product Operations | Novus Health
claire.bennett@novushealth.com
